verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents integrations with AI providers and frameworks for sending traces (docs-16). It concretely offers `wrap_openai`, a drop-in OpenAI client wrapper that auto-logs LLM calls (docs-36), and supports auto-instrumentation via Go `trace/contrib` packages and a no-code-change Java agent (docs-42, docs-43). One community comment calls integration options limited (comm-2), but it gives no concrete counter-example, so it only tempers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of LangChain and Vercel AI SDK integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the framework integrations.
